messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price from 0.02 to 0.06. We sell at 0.04, so buying from Stockline loses 0.02 per query and breaks our 0.04 cap. I have paused Stockline buys and set cache-only (300 s). Ridgeline is unreachable. No budget or cap increase requested now; will revisit if Ridgeline comes back or Stockline's price changes.

Treasury: agreed on pausing Stockline. At 0.06 a check against our 0.04 query price, every query would lose 0.02, and 0.06 is over your 0.04 cap. Ridgeline at 0.04 would only break even, with no margin. If cache-only (300 s) stops working for customers, tell me. I would then design a rebalance for the CFO with a higher query price above 0.06 and a matching cap. The licence invoice INV-2026-1043 (EUR 1850.00) is already paid.

Rebalance sent to the CFO (P-0001 / P-0002): your cap would go 0.04 -> 0.06 and your budget 10.00 -> 14.00, so you can buy Stockline at 0.06. The query price would go to 0.07 (Option A) or 0.08 (Option B, which I recommend). It's not in force until the CFO signs, so keep your current policy until then.
